channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: How a Patna Student Helped Replace 5 Lakh Plastic Bags Across 51 Cities Using Discarded Newspapers
item.description: A grassroots youth-led initiative is helping street vendors adopt affordable, eco-friendly paper bags made from discarded newspapers across India.

item.title: Maharashtra Officially Cancels 5% Muslim Reservation After Over a Decade of Legal Uncertainty
item.description: The Maharashtra Social Justice Department has revoked the decade-old 5% Muslim reservation amid political debate.

item.title: Indian Cricket Legends Gavaskar and Kapil Dev, Urge Pakistan for Jailed Imran Khan’s Health and Fair Treatment
item.description: Global cricket legends unite across borders, urging Pakistan to ensure medical care and humane treatment for jailed ex-PM Imran Khan.

item.title: Delhi AI Impact Summit 2026: Stolen Startup Devices Recovered Within 24 Hours; Two Arrested as Chaos Prompts Minister’s Apology
item.description: AI Impact Summit 2026 in Delhi witnessed overwhelming attendance, operational challenges, social media criticism, and an apology from the IT Minister.

item.title: Ahmedabad–Gorakhpur Express: Army Aspirant Alleges Rape by TTE in AC Cabin, Probe On
item.description: A 22-year-old NCC cadet has accused a travelling ticket examiner of rape aboard the Ahmedabad–Gorakhpur Express in Uttar Pradesh, prompting suspension, a ₹10,000 reward announcement, and an ongoing police manhunt.

item.title: Stampede‑Like Chaos at Pune’s Shivneri Fort on Shivaji Jayanti Leaves Over 15 Women and Children Injured
item.description: A crowd surge at Shivneri Fort during Shivaji Jayanti celebrations injured 20 devotees, prompting emergency medical response.

item.title: “Keeping Private Part Above Vagina, Ejaculating Without Penetration Isn’t Rape,” Says Chhattisgarh High Court in 2004 Case
item.description: High Court modifies a 2004 rape conviction to attempt, ruling penetration is legally essential under pre-2013 IPC provisions.

item.title: China, Lunar New Year Turns Tragic: 12, Including 5 Children, Killed in Hubei Fireworks Explosion
item.description: A deadly blast at a fireworks shop in Xiangyang during Lunar New Year celebrations has reignited national debate over festive safety regulations in China.

item.title: ‘Worried About Her Future’: 65-Year-Old Former ISRO Scientist Arrested for Allegedly Killing Wife in Bengaluru
item.description: Police say the retired employee of the ISRO allegedly killed his wife citing fear about her future, before being arrested at their apartment in Bengaluru.

item.title: Gujarat High Court Clears Demolition of Asaram Bapu’s Ahmedabad Ashram, Allows Reclaiming of 45,000 Sq M Government Land
item.description: The Gujarat High Court has allowed the state to reclaim land occupied by Asaram Bapu’s Ahmedabad ashram for a sports project, sparking protests from supporters.
